sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and passes deterministic validation. It correctly targets ships, gates applicability on IB or IC plus the 1985 regulation edition, enforces presence of both power quantities in canonical kW units, and rejects values where maximum continuous rating power is below the required power. No datatype restriction or unsupported vocabulary term is introduced.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove all FILTER (DATATYPE(?value) = xsd:decimal) checks for both power quantities: the canonical metadata declares no datatype, so xsd:decimal is an unsupported guessed restriction. Retain the declared kW unit checks and the existing violation comparison (?maximumValue < ?requiredValue).

Use the canonical kW unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloW in every unit check. The current qudt prefix maps qudt:KiloW to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/KiloW, which is not the declared unit. Declare a separate prefix such as unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> and replace all occurrences of qudt:KiloW with unit:KiloW. Preserve the prior instruction: do not add guessed xsd:decimal datatype checks.

The candidate is semantically faithful and passes deterministic validation. It correctly targets ships, gates applicability on IB or IC plus the 1985 regulation edition, enforces presence of both power quantities in canonical kW units, and rejects values where maximum continuous rating power is below the required power. No datatype restriction or unsupported vocabulary term is introduced.
